sources.title: Missouri Secretary of State, Official Election Returns, General Election 2010, results by county (Kansas City listed as its own jurisdiction) (pdf)
Missouri Secretary of State, Official Election Returns, General Election 2010, statewide totals (pdf)

method: Kansas City (Kansas City Board of Election Commissioners, the Jackson County part of the city) U.S. Senator votes transcribed from the official county-by-county returns PDF (text extracted with pdftotext; PDFs kept in data/raw/state/2010_MO_SEN_kc/) into one row added to Jackson County 29095; oth = Dine (LIB) 1,433, Beck (CST) 773, write-ins 0. Needed because Amlani & Algara's Missouri 2010 U.S. Senator county rows omit Kansas City (statewide shortfall equals Kansas City exactly).
validation: Amlani statewide dem 727,288 + KC 62,448 = 789,736 vs certified Robin Carnahan 789,736: +0 (+0.00%); Amlani statewide rep 1,032,294 + KC 21,866 = 1,054,160 vs certified Roy Blunt 1,054,160: +0 (+0.00%). KC row sums to the official KC total of 86,520.
